name: A scene from the war in Ukraine - Cinematic Lighting Study
author: e_babayev
description: The scene you see below is not a frame from any game or movie. This scene is a photo of a burn in a heavily damaged school in Lysychansk, Ukraine, during the Russian attack on Ukraine. I animated this photo, which shows the bitter sides of the war, as a cinematic lighting work in the Unity game engine. For more photo: https://emilazerbaijan.artstation.com/projects/nEPmxX
